en: Black‑and‑white image of a broad town square with historic gabled houses and small businesses around the perimeter. In the center foreground is an unpaved square with a horse‑drawn carriage and wagon. The central building has an ornate Baroque façade with many windows; surrounding houses have steep tiled roofs with dormers. Signs on the buildings advertise a hotel, clothing shop, and restaurant in German.
